plan.title: Vendor counter-offer decline and modify choices

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow for the RFQ event.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product needed for the vendor bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite the QA vendor who will receive and inspect the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Verify the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the bid can be countered.
Send a pending buyer counter offer to the vendor.
Confirm the buyer grid shows the counter offer as initiated.
Continue as the invited vendor in the supplier portal.
Open the event's RFQ pricing view containing the pending counter-offer banner.
Confirm the pending counter-offer banner is visible.
Open the vendor's counter-offer response dialog.
Verify that a response dialog opened.
Assert the dialog offers a decline choice.
Assert the dialog offers the required modify-counter-offer choice.
